selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main message do all kinds of trees and plants agree on in this passage?
questions.answer: They all point to Allah’s oneness and necessary existence.

questions.question: What does the agreement of all plant species point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: Name the three plant features used as signs in the passage.
questions.answer: Leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What does the orderly look of plant parts teach us?
questions.answer: It teaches that they were arranged with care and wisdom.

questions.question: What do well-formed fruits suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest order, purpose, and beneficial giving.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention mercy together with giving?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s gifts are caring and purposeful.

questions.question: Why is that change from similar seeds to many different plants important?
questions.answer: It is a clear sign of Allah’s power, wisdom, and will.

questions.question: From what simple beginnings do many plant forms open up?
questions.answer: They open up from seeds and grains.

questions.question: What do these actions show about the Creator?
questions.answer: They show that the Creator has will and wisdom.

questions.question: Why is this contrast important for understanding Tawhid?
questions.answer: It shows one wise Lord is controlling and designing all of it.

questions.question: Who is being glorified by all the species of trees and plants in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah is being glorified.

questions.question: What shared testimony do they give?
questions.answer: They all bear witness to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Why are leaves, flowers, and fruits mentioned one after another?
questions.answer: To show that many parts of plants all give the same message.

questions.question: What do lovely flowers suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest beauty, generosity, and mercy.

questions.question: What example from plants shows provision and kindness?
questions.answer: Their fruits and the blessings found in them show provision and kindness.

questions.question: What surprising change happens from those similar seeds and grains?
questions.answer: Many different, beautiful, and balanced forms come out from them.

questions.question: What does adornment in plants help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove that their Maker acts with wisdom and beauty.

questions.question: What three actions show careful design in plants besides giving blessings?
questions.answer: Making them different, beautifying them, and shaping them.

questions.question: What contrast is the passage asking us to notice?
questions.answer: It asks us to notice that many different plant forms come from simple, similar seeds.

questions.question: What does the phrase about unlimited forms help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand the amazing variety Allah brings out in creation.

questions.question: What group in creation is the focus of this passage?
questions.answer: The passage focuses on trees and plants.

questions.question: What belief do they support together?
questions.answer: They support belief in Allah alone.

questions.question: What do balanced leaves suggest about their Maker?
questions.answer: They suggest careful planning and wisdom.

questions.question: What example from plants shows beauty?
questions.answer: Their flowers and other decorated forms show beauty.
